searchText: I'm still leaning towards providing an `auth` map to the `eth_estimateGas` so you get something that looks like: ``` { "jsonrpc":"2.0", "method":"eth_estimateGas", "id":1, "params":[{tx_object}, "pending", { "0xAfakeADDRESS" => "0xmyREALaddress" }] } ``` And in the result, you have: ``` { "id":1, "jsonrpc": "2.0", "result": [ "0x", { "0xAcommitHash" => "0xMAXgasFORthatCOMMIT", "0xAnotherCommitHash" => "0xDifferentMaxGasForThisCommit" } ] } ``` The Gnosis Safe does something similar in having a designated reverting path for gas estimation. It sounds like the extra step would be allowing a dummy commit to approximate the same behavior as a future commit, but having at least an initial solution for this at the smart contract level does seem preferable. https://github.com/gnosis/safe-contracts/blob/39b69e21bb72a037341fe2ac799727d0ce00b011/contracts/GnosisSafe.sol#L284-L304
